design_issues.screen: Multiple modals (ProductOptions, Payment, Success, Product edit, Stok adjust)
issues: Radix DialogContent console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Non-blocking but should wrap invisible DialogTitle/Description with VisuallyHidden for a11y compliance.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Add DialogTitle + DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden wrappers) to Radix Dialog components to remove a11y console warnings in ProductOptionsModal, PaymentModal, SuccessScreen, product edit dialog, and stock adjust dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 735 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, products.py, checkout.py, reports.py, seed.py) for maintainability.

Checkout stock deduction is not atomic: stock is validated then deducted in separate awaits per item; a race between two concurrent checkouts on the same product could over-sell. Consider using find_one_and_update with $inc + condition, or a transaction, for production safety.
Monthly report bucketing uses `datetime.now - timedelta(days=i*30)` which drifts across months with different day counts; use dateutil.relativedelta or manual month math for accurate monthly buckets.

Duplicate NavItems rendered in mobile drawer share the same data-testid values as desktop sidebar — when drawer opens on mobile, selectors will match two elements. Consider suffixing (nav-kasir-mobile) or scoping.
CORS `allow_origins` only accepts FRONTEND_URL + localhost; the actual preview URL depends on env — verify FRONTEND_URL matches production URL.
seed() ADMIN_EMAIL/CASHIER_EMAIL etc. from env is idempotent and updates password on change — good.
